sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You move at the speed of intent, instantly strike out with it faster than the eye can see, at a creature within range, shattering the air like glass as you move.

Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d10 Wind or Lightning damage if a ninjutsu attack or your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] + 2d10 if a Taijutsu attack.

Interdiction Seal. When your attack lands, you prime the seal as it glows an ominous color of your choosing, if the affected creature willingly moves before the beginning of your next turn, the seal detonates with compressive force. The affected creature takes 3d10 force damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, on a failed save they are teleported into a space that can hold them as close as possible to another creature or object marked with your Speed Seal. If no other creature is marked in this way, they do not teleport.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10 and you can make one additional attack against another creature within range.
